label: LDAP identity provider
type: an LDAP directory used as an external identity provider for Server's external authentication domain. NOT to be merged with Capella's sso:realm/sso:group-mapping family: Capella registers an IdP at the management plane and maps groups to Capella teams/roles, whereas Server's LDAP integration resolves to its own local role and group catalogue.
note: Highest-recurrence member of the new idp: namespace. Kept separate from the sso:* family on the standing no-silent-merge rule - the two federate to an external directory for two structurally different downstream authorization models, and no page states they are the same mechanism.
